newsitem.title: USA: Enviro-Recovery closes Resource Recovery merger.
newsitem.headline: Enviro-Recovery closes Resource Recovery merger.

text.p: Enviro-Recovery Inc said Monday it completed a merger with Resource Recovery Inc, a Florida-based corporation which recently acquired Superior Water-Logged Lumber Co Inc.

Superior operates a 125,000 square foot wood processing facility, which recovers and processes logs from forests that were cut down about 100-150 years ago. These sunken logs, up to 500 years old, were preserved by the cold waters and low oxygen content under the Great Lakes.
Enviro-Recovery said the merger will allow the company to move from its developmental stage to full operational status with revenues already on line for the 1997 year.
